contract_term.value: 1-year initial term with options to extend for four additional 1-year renewal periods, total term not to exceed 5 years
contract_term.quote: The term of the agreement resulting from this RFP is to be for a period of one (1) year, with options to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions for four (4) additional 1-year renewal periods for a total term not to exceed five (5) years collectively.

scope_of_deliverables.value: CMHC is seeking Reference Data Management Services across three streams: (1) Develop and Implement an Operating Model for RDM, (2) Adoption of RDM Governance and Policy, and (3) Implement a Sustainable Technical Solution, utilizing existing Informatica IDMC, Collibra, and Azure deployments.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: The Three stream are: 1. Develop and Implement an Operating Model for Reference Data Management (RDM) 2. Adoption of RDM Governance and Policy 3. Implement a Sustainable Technical Solution

value: Data Residency: The selected proponent must comply with the following: CMHC Data, while at rest or in transit must stay within the geographical boundaries of Canada and accessed from within Canada.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is worth 20 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a relative pricing formula using the rates set out in the Pricing Form. Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price for the particular category it has bid on, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: Lowest price ÷ proponent's price x weighting = proponent's pricing points. Submission format: The proponent must provide a response relative to the pricing of its proposed solution. insurance_requirements.quote: Commercial General Liability insurance with an insurer licensed to do business in Canada with a limit of not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000) inclusive for personal injury, bodily injury (including death) and property damage for any one occurrence or series of occurrences arising from one cause. Technology Errors & Omissions Liability insurance with an insurer licensed to do business in Canada with a limit of not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000) per claim. Professional Errors & Omissions Liability insurance with an insurer licensed to do business in Canada with a limit of not less than five million dollars ($5,000,000) per claim. Computer Security and Privacy Liability with an insurer licensed to do business in Canada with a limit of not less than ten million dollars ($10,000,000) per claim and aggregate.

value: CMHC Data classified Protected B or higher, including personal information, must be safeguarded with required IT infrastructure
CMHC Information must be encrypted while in transit and at rest at a minimum 128-bit encryption throughout the Term
Contractor Personnel and its facilities must be security cleared with Government of Canada Reliability status at the start date of this Agreement

CMHC Information shall always remain and be accessed from/within Canada and by individuals who have obtained the appropriate security screening as per Government of Canada security screening classification
Contractor shall conduct regular security assessments to ensure safeguards are working effectively
Contractor shall ensure all CMHC Information is encrypted while in transit and at rest at a minimum 128-bit encryption throughout the Term
Contractor Personnel may be required to undergo criminal records check or hold a valid personnel security screening at the level required in writing by CMHC prior to commencement of any Services
Contractor shall ensure that all CMHC Data will reside in Canada at all times
data_security_requirements.quote: Proponents must demonstrate that they have the required IT infrastructure in place to safeguard CMHC Data classified Protected B or higher, including personal information.
